subject: Partitioned invoice settlement for Alpha Group — VAT & cost-center mapping
messages:
From: Elisa Ramos <elisa.ramos@novopulse.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@novopulse.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Billing split request for Alpha Group (UK + DE entities)

Hi Ava,

Following our renewal call, Finance at Alpha Group has asked us to issue separate invoice obligations for the two legal entities that will be remitting payment: Alpha Ltd (UK) and Alpha GmbH (DE). Summary of the split they want: 70% payable by Alpha Ltd (UK) and 30% payable by Alpha GmbH (DE).

Requirements from their AP team:
- Two invoice numbers (one per legal entity) reflecting their respective VAT treatment.
- Visible VAT registration for each invoice (we've provided both VAT IDs below).
- Each invoice should include a cost center tag so internal GL mapping at Alpha works on receipt.
- They want a single remittance advice PDF for their bank to process but the invoices must be separate.

VAT / legal names / VAT IDs (source: Alpha AP):
- Alpha Ltd (UK) - Company name: Alpha Limited, VAT: GB123456789
- Alpha GmbH (DE) - Company name: Alpha GmbH, VAT: DE987654321

Can Redwood issue two invoices with the above split and confirm the cost center field mapping we can populate on the invoice PDF? Also attaching a quick suggested payment schedule in case it helps (we're open to doing net30 combined submission but separate payments to each entity).

Attachment: payment_schedule_proposal.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Elisa Ramos
Head of Finance Operations
NovoPulse

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Elisa Ramos <elisa.ramos@novopulse.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing split request for Alpha Group (UK + DE entities)

Hi Elisa — thanks for the clear breakdown. Yes, we can do this; outlining next steps so accounting and AP have a single source of truth: 

1) Redwood billing will generate two invoice PDFs with separate invoice numbers (one per legal entity). Each PDF will include: legal name, VAT ID, and a custom field labeled "Alpha_cost_center" where we will write exactly the cost-center string you provide.

2) We'll apply a 70/30 split to the invoice amounts (we'll round to the nearest cent and include a short line item noting the split for auditability).

3) We can attach a single remittance advice PDF for your bank; our billing ops will include it in the delivery bundle and set the file name to "remittance_advice.pdf".

Questions for you (please confirm by EOD):
- Exact Alpha cost center strings for UK and DE (format e.g. CC-12345-ENG).
- Preferred invoice date and desired payment terms (net30 / net45).

Marissa — tagging you for invoice creation and to confirm ledger tags / GL account mapping. Karthik — FYI for deal & revenue recognition.

Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing split request for Alpha Group (UK + DE entities)

Ava — thanks. Two quick points from revenue side: 
- Recognize that contractually the customer remains a single agreement (DEAL-8732), but having two invoice artifacts is fine for AP as long as the total amount maps back to the single subscription line for reporting.
- When Marissa creates the invoices, include a hidden field (for our internal export) named "deal_id" = DEAL-8732 so revenue ops can tie both invoices to the contract.

Marissa — can billing add that metadata to the invoice PDF? If you need any specific formatting to preserve VAT lines for DE/UK, flag it now.

Thanks,
Karthik
VP Sales Operations

From: Elisa Ramos <elisa.ramos@novopulse.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: NovoPulse Finance <finance@novopulse.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing split request for Alpha Group (UK + DE entities)

Hi all — apologies for the delay, finance returned the exact mapping: 
- Alpha Ltd (UK) cost center: CC-UK-4512
- Alpha GmbH (DE) cost center: CC-DE-3019

They want invoice date 2027-07-14 and net30 terms. Banking instructions:
- Alpha Ltd (UK) - GBP BACS account: sort 40-11-22 acct 12345678 (reference: REDWOOD-ALPHA-UK)
- Alpha GmbH (DE) - SEPA IBAN: DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00 (reference: REDWOOD-ALPHA-DE)

They prefer separate remittances to each bank but will upload a single remittance advice to their TMS. Attached is their remit PDF with banking details.

Attachment: alpha_remit_details.pdf (stub)

Please confirm when draft invoices are ready and whether you need any additional legal language for cross-border VAT on the DE invoice.

Best,
Elisa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elisa Ramos <elisa.ramos@novopulse.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Draft invoices and GL mapping for Alpha Group (for review)

Hi Elisa / team — attaching the draft PDFs for review. I created two invoices with the requested split and included the cost center string in a labeled field on each PDF. I also embedded the hidden metadata line: deal_id: DEAL-8732 for revenue ops.

Attachments:
- INV-20270714-ALPHA-UK.pdf (70% of total; includes VAT GB123456789)
- INV-20270714-ALPHA-DE.pdf (30% of total; VAT line shows DE987654321 and VAT handling as reverse charge placeholder per DE rules)
- remittance_advice.pdf (single remittance advice combining both invoice references)

Notes / action items:
- Elisa: please confirm the VAT presentation on the DE invoice is acceptable to Alpha (we used a reverse-charge line and included the DE VAT ID explicitly).
- Finance team at Alpha: please confirm you will send separate payments to the respective bank accounts above and include the invoice reference in the payment description.
- Karthik: revenue ops — I'll hand off the invoice exports (CSV) that include the hidden deal_id and the cost_center fields after you confirm the format.

If I don't hear changes by EOD tomorrow we'll finalize and post the invoices to Alpha's billing contacts and SFTP bundle.

Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Elisa Ramos <elisa.ramos@novopulse.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: NovoPulse Finance <finance@novopulse.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft invoices and GL mapping for Alpha Group (for review)

Marissa — all good from our side. VAT formatting on the DE invoice is fine; finance confirms they will issue two transfers (one BACS to Alpha Ltd, one SEPA to Alpha GmbH). Expected payment date: 2027-08-13 (net30 from invoice date). Payment references will include invoice numbers as shown.

We'll proceed to pay per the remittance advice. Please send final PDFs to payments@novopulse.com and we'll let you know once the transfers are initiated.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Elisa Ramos
Head of Finance Operations, NovoPulse
